criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward consistency) and Criterion 4 (Next steps specificity)
suggested_change: Criterion 2: Add explicit rule: 'Silence or absence of new information does NOT constitute contradiction. Maintain prior level and document as "No new evidence in [Call N]—score held at X/10." Only adjust score if call contains explicit contradictory evidence.' Criterion 4: Revise to require action-specific language with owner and date: 'Next steps must name the person, specify the deliverable, include target date, and state the success condition (e.g., "Send Dmitry business case template by [date]; request he share with [stakeholder name] and confirm receipt by [date].")'
